note: BoE IADB CFMHSDE: effective interest rate, UK MFIs' sterling secured loans to households, OUTSTANDING (stock), monthly
BoE IADB CFMHSCV: UNVERIFIED code (values 0.1-3.5%: not a mortgage rate); downloaded by mistake, NOT used
BoE IADB IUMBV34: quoted rate, 2-year fixed mortgage (75% LTV), monthly average
BoE IADB IUMBV42: quoted rate, 5-year fixed mortgage (75% LTV), monthly average
BoE IADB IUMTLMV: quoted rate, standard variable rate (SVR), monthly average
ONS J5II: PS net borrowing ex public sector banks, GBP m, NSA (negative = borrowing); used for GBR govDeficitGdp (round 2)
ONS HF6X: PS net debt ex public sector banks, % of GDP, NSA (not used: the engine targets the BIS general-government ratio)
ONS NMFX: CG current expenditure: net interest payable, GBP m, NSA; used for GBR govInterestGdp (round 2)
World Bank FB.AST.NPER.ZS: bank nonperforming loans / total gross loans, %, annual (IMF FSI); GBR bankNplRatio, display only (B2 card)
